en.text: A false balance is an abomination to the LORD, but accurate weights are his delight.

zhSimplified.text: 诡诈的天平为耶和华所憎恶； 公平的法码为他所喜悦。

zhTraditional.text: 詭詐的天平為耶和華所憎惡； 公平的法碼為他所喜悅。

en.text: When pride comes, then comes shame, but with humility comes wisdom.

zhSimplified.text: 骄傲来，羞耻也来； 谦逊人却有智慧。

zhTraditional.text: 驕傲來，羞恥也來； 謙遜人卻有智慧。

en.text: The integrity of the upright shall guide them, but the perverseness of the treacherous shall destroy them.

zhSimplified.text: 正直人的纯正必引导自己； 奸诈人的乖僻必毁灭自己。

zhTraditional.text: 正直人的純正必引導自己； 奸詐人的乖僻必毀滅自己。

en.text: Riches don’t profit in the day of wrath, but righteousness delivers from death.

zhSimplified.text: 发怒的日子资财无益； 惟有公义能救人脱离死亡。

zhTraditional.text: 發怒的日子資財無益； 惟有公義能救人脫離死亡。

en.text: The righteousness of the blameless will direct his way, but the wicked shall fall by his own wickedness.

zhSimplified.text: 完全人的义必指引他的路； 但恶人必因自己的恶跌倒。

zhTraditional.text: 完全人的義必指引他的路； 但惡人必因自己的惡跌倒。

en.text: The righteousness of the upright shall deliver them, but the unfaithful will be trapped by evil desires.

zhSimplified.text: 正直人的义必拯救自己； 奸诈人必陷在自己的罪孽中。

zhTraditional.text: 正直人的義必拯救自己； 奸詐人必陷在自己的罪孽中。

en.text: When a wicked man dies, hope perishes, and expectation of power comes to nothing.

zhSimplified.text: 恶人一死，他的指望必灭绝； 罪人的盼望也必灭没。

zhTraditional.text: 惡人一死，他的指望必滅絕； 罪人的盼望也必滅沒。

en.text: A righteous person is delivered out of trouble, and the wicked takes his place.

zhSimplified.text: 义人得脱离患难， 有恶人来代替他。

zhTraditional.text: 義人得脫離患難， 有惡人來代替他。

en.text: With his mouth the godless man destroys his neighbor, but the righteous will be delivered through knowledge.

zhSimplified.text: 不虔敬的人用口败坏邻舍； 义人却因知识得救。

zhTraditional.text: 不虔敬的人用口敗壞鄰舍； 義人卻因知識得救。

en.text: When it goes well with the righteous, the city rejoices. When the wicked perish, there is shouting.

zhSimplified.text: 义人享福，合城喜乐； 恶人灭亡，人都欢呼。

zhTraditional.text: 義人享福，合城喜樂； 惡人滅亡，人都歡呼。

en.text: By the blessing of the upright, the city is exalted, but it is overthrown by the mouth of the wicked.

zhSimplified.text: 城因正直人祝福便高举， 却因邪恶人的口就倾覆。

zhTraditional.text: 城因正直人祝福便高舉， 卻因邪惡人的口就傾覆。

en.text: One who despises his neighbor is void of wisdom, but a man of understanding holds his peace.

zhSimplified.text: 藐视邻舍的，毫无智慧； 明哲人却静默不言。

zhTraditional.text: 藐視鄰舍的，毫無智慧； 明哲人卻靜默不言。

en.text: One who brings gossip betrays a confidence, but one who is of a trustworthy spirit is one who keeps a secret.

zhSimplified.text: 往来传舌的，泄漏密事； 心中诚实的，遮隐事情。

zhTraditional.text: 往來傳舌的，洩漏密事； 心中誠實的，遮隱事情。

en.text: Where there is no wise guidance, the nation falls, but in the multitude of counselors there is victory.

zhSimplified.text: 无智谋，民就败落； 谋士多，人便安居。

zhTraditional.text: 無智謀，民就敗落； 謀士多，人便安居。

en.text: He who is collateral for a stranger will suffer for it, but he who refuses pledges of collateral is secure.

zhSimplified.text: 为外人作保的，必受亏损； 恨恶击掌的，却得安稳。

zhTraditional.text: 為外人作保的，必受虧損； 恨惡擊掌的，卻得安穩。

en.text: A gracious woman obtains honor, but violent men obtain riches.

zhSimplified.text: 恩德的妇女得尊荣； 强暴的男子得资财。

zhTraditional.text: 恩德的婦女得尊榮； 強暴的男子得資財。

en.text: The merciful man does good to his own soul, but he who is cruel troubles his own flesh.

zhSimplified.text: 仁慈的人善待自己； 残忍的人扰害己身。

zhTraditional.text: 仁慈的人善待自己； 殘忍的人擾害己身。

en.text: Wicked people earn deceitful wages, but one who sows righteousness reaps a sure reward.

zhSimplified.text: 恶人经营，得虚浮的工价； 撒义种的，得实在的果效。

zhTraditional.text: 惡人經營，得虛浮的工價； 撒義種的，得實在的果效。

en.text: He who is truly righteous gets life. He who pursues evil gets death.

zhSimplified.text: 恒心为义的，必得生命； 追求邪恶的，必致死亡。

zhTraditional.text: 恆心為義的，必得生命； 追求邪惡的，必致死亡。

en.text: Those who are perverse in heart are an abomination to the LORD, but those whose ways are blameless are his delight.

zhSimplified.text: 心中乖僻的，为耶和华所憎恶； 行事完全的，为他所喜悦。

zhTraditional.text: 心中乖僻的，為耶和華所憎惡； 行事完全的，為他所喜悅。

en.text: Most certainly, the evil man will not be unpunished, but the offspring of the righteous will be delivered.

zhSimplified.text: 恶人虽然连手，必不免受罚； 义人的后裔必得拯救。

zhTraditional.text: 惡人雖然連手，必不免受罰； 義人的後裔必得拯救。

en.text: Like a gold ring in a pig’s snout, is a beautiful woman who lacks discretion.

zhSimplified.text: 妇女美貌而无见识， 如同金环带在猪鼻上。

zhTraditional.text: 婦女美貌而無見識， 如同金環帶在豬鼻上。

en.text: The desire of the righteous is only good. The expectation of the wicked is wrath.

zhSimplified.text: 义人的心愿尽得好处； 恶人的指望致干忿怒。

zhTraditional.text: 義人的心願盡得好處； 惡人的指望致干忿怒。

en.text: There is one who scatters, and increases yet more. There is one who withholds more than is appropriate, but gains poverty.

zhSimplified.text: 有施散的，却更增添； 有吝惜过度的，反致穷乏。

zhTraditional.text: 有施散的，卻更增添； 有吝惜過度的，反致窮乏。

en.text: The liberal soul shall be made fat. He who waters shall be watered also himself.

zhSimplified.text: 好施舍的，必得丰裕； 滋润人的，必得滋润。

zhTraditional.text: 好施捨的，必得豐裕； 滋潤人的，必得滋潤。

en.text: People curse someone who withholds grain, but blessing will be on the head of him who sells it.

zhSimplified.text: 屯粮不卖的，民必咒诅他； 情愿出卖的，人必为他祝福。

zhTraditional.text: 屯糧不賣的，民必咒詛他； 情願出賣的，人必為他祝福。

en.text: He who diligently seeks good seeks favor, but he who searches after evil, it shall come to him.

zhSimplified.text: 恳切求善的，就求得恩惠； 惟独求恶的，恶必临到他身。

zhTraditional.text: 懇切求善的，就求得恩惠； 惟獨求惡的，惡必臨到他身。

en.text: He who trusts in his riches will fall, but the righteous shall flourish as the green leaf.

zhSimplified.text: 倚仗自己财物的，必跌倒； 义人必发旺，如青叶。

zhTraditional.text: 倚仗自己財物的，必跌倒； 義人必發旺，如青葉。

en.text: He who troubles his own house shall inherit the wind. The foolish shall be servant to the wise of heart.

zhSimplified.text: 扰害己家的，必承受清风； 愚昧人必作慧心人的仆人。

zhTraditional.text: 擾害己家的，必承受清風； 愚昧人必作慧心人的僕人。

en.text: The fruit of the righteous is a tree of life. He who is wise wins souls.

zhSimplified.text: 义人所结的果子就是生命树； 有智慧的，必能得人。

zhTraditional.text: 義人所結的果子就是生命樹； 有智慧的，必能得人。

en.text: Behold, the righteous shall be repaid on the earth, how much more the wicked and the sinner!

zhSimplified.text: 看哪，义人在世尚且受报， 何况恶人和罪人呢？

zhTraditional.text: 看哪，義人在世尚且受報， 何況惡人和罪人呢？
